description: The Hammersley process is a particle system related to longest increasing subsequences. The LCS of binary strings maps to a variant of the Hammersley process with an exploration penalty. Georgiou-Ortmann (2018) studied the discrete Hammersley process and obtained Tracy-Widom fluctuations at zero penalty. Coupling to nonzero penalty could yield new bounds.
mathematical_formalization: Discrete Hammersley process on n x n grid with Bernoulli(p) points: LPP time T_n satisfies E[T_n]/n -> c(p). For p=1/2: c(1/2) = 2(sqrt(2)-1). For true LCS, introduce penalty lambda for correlations: gamma_2 = c(1/2) - Delta(lambda*).
implementation_hypothesis: Implement discrete Hammersley process with exploration penalty. Vary penalty parameter and measure LPP time. Tune to match true LCS statistics.
experiment_seed: Simulate for n=1000 with lambda=0, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1. Plot E[T_n]/n vs lambda. Compare lambda=0 with 2(sqrt(2)-1).
